premises.text: Large buyers lack usable information on suppliers' environmental sustainability and are flying blind as consumers, shareholders, and media scrutinize supply-chain scandals
premises.evidence_span: they don't have almost any information on their supplier's environmental sustainability

premises.text: SupplyShift is an integrated platform for sending scorecards, analyzing supply-chain risk on the fly, and comparing suppliers on weighted environmental issues
premises.evidence_span: We've developed the first truly integrated platform that helps companies understand and manage their supply chain sustainability, as well as evaluate supply chain risk, and drive their suppliers to be better

premises.text: Suppliers see peer benchmarks and know buyers can view anonymous outside scores, incentivizing improvement and matching sustainable suppliers to more business
premises.evidence_span: suppliers get a very similar dashboard. Now, Spacely Sprockets can see where it stands relative to its industry peers, and that's a game changer

premises.text: A unified scorecard library reduces RFP fatigue by standardizing popular questionnaires so suppliers answer once
premises.evidence_span: we have a unified scorecard library that fixes the RFP fatigue problem

premises.text: Pricing is an annual fee plus a small fee per supplier once suppliers enroll and buyers integrate them into the network
premises.evidence_span: once suppliers enroll, they pay a annual fee plus a small fee per supplier

value.text: Enterprises avoid environmental supply-chain scandals and choose more sustainable suppliers with confidence
value.evidence_span: We're about to show you a product that helps avoid these scandals

secondary_value.text: Buyers can take advantage of expanding markets for sustainable products
secondary_value.evidence_span: you'd like to take advantage of the expanding market for sustainable products

causal_links.evidence_span: companies have very little information and are flying blind
buyers have access to more sustainable suppliers, and more sustainable suppliers get more business
they will know exactly which suppliers to use. And they'll know that they won't have to deal with environmental disaster headlines

notes: Buyer blindness and stakeholder scrutiny folded as one problem (§4.1.6). Scorecards, risk drill-downs, supplier peer dashboards, anonymous outside scores, and unified library folded as cascade/packages of one network platform (§4.1.7). Analytics/uploads/quality scoring listed features folded into platform. Consulting background treated as credibility, not a premise. GRI reporting growth treated as market timing framing. Three domains problem/platform/pricing—anti-template: fee schedule separately revisable from network mechanics.
